name: answer-checklist
title: Answer checklist
description: A checklist where each item gets an answer, Pass, Fail or N/A, or Yes and No, with a note that opens on the answers that need explaining.
docs: items are the statements (id, label, hint, notePlaceholder) and options the answers: value, label and an optional tone (pass, fail or skip) that sets the shape of the mark; the default is Pass, Fail and Not applicable. value maps a statement id to { answer, note }, and onValueChange receives the whole map. noteOn lists the answers that need a note: choosing one opens a required textarea under the row, and the row stays open, marked "Note required", until it has text; the note is kept if the answer changes. Each row is a radio group (the house segmented control) named by its statement and hint, and shows its state in a mark and in words. The header counts what is left ("7 of 12 answered, 1 note missing") in a polite live region next to a thin Progress, and Jump to next unanswered moves focus to the first open row: to its answer, or to its empty note. On a phone the control wraps under the statement at full width. labels renames every word.
